div.div: طُرْطُبَّةٌ A woman having long breasts: (S, TA:) or having large breasts: or having flabby breasts. (TA.) And, or accord. to the TA and some copies of the K ↓ طُرْطُبَةٌ , (said in the TA to be without teshdeed,) as also ↓ طُرْطُبَانِيَّةٌ , Having a long udder: (K:) or a she-goat having long teats. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
